question: A circle is inscribed in an equilateral triangle of side 24 cm. What is the area (in cm<sup>2</sup>) of a square inscribed in the circle?
question_hi: एक वृत्त 24 सेंटीमीटर भुजा वाले एक समबाहु त्रिभुज के अंदर बना है। वृत्त के अंदर बने वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल (सेंटीमीटर<sup>2</sup> में) क्या है?
solution:
Given:-

Side of triangle = 24 cm

Formula used:-

In-radius of triangle = a/2√ 3

Area of square = (Diagonal)2/2

Calculation:-

Side of triangle (a) = 24 cm

In-radius of triangle = a/2√3 = 24/2√3 = 4√3

As we know,

Diagonal of inscribed square = 2r = 2 × 4√3 = 8√3

Area of square = (Diagonal)2/2

Area of square = (8√3)2/2 = (64 × 3)/2 = 96 cm2

∴ Required square area is 96 cm2.
solution_hi:
दिया है:-

त्रिभुज की भुजा = 24 सेंटीमीटर

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:-

त्रिभुज की त्रिज्या = a/2√ 3

वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = (विकर्ण)2/2

गणना:-

त्रिभुज की भुजा (a) = 24 सेंटीमीटर

त्रिभुज की आंतरिक त्रिज्या = a/2√3 = 24/2√3 = 4√3

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं,

उत्कीर्ण वर्ग का विकर्ण = 2r = 2 × 4√3 = 8√3

वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = (विकर्ण)2/2

वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = (8√3)2/2 = (64 × 3)/2 = 96 सेंटीमीटर2

∴ अभीष्ट वर्ग क्षेत्रफल 96 सेंटीमीटर2 है।

question: When 3738, 5659 and 9501 are divided by the greatest possible number x, the remainder in each case is y. what is the sum of x and y?
question_hi: जब 3738, 5659 और 9501 को अधिकतम संभावित संख्या x से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो प्रत्येक स्थिति में शेषफल y प्राप्त होता है। x और y का योग कितना है?
solution:
Given:-

Three numbers = 3738, 5659, 9501

Concept used:-

HCF(D1,D2,D3) = Greatest number which gives same remainder

Calculation:-

If remainder in each case is the same, then: 

D1 = 5659 – 3738 = 1921

D2 = 9501 – 5659 = 3842

D3 = 9501 – 3738 = 5763

HCF of 1921, 3842 and 5763 = (x) = 1921

When 3738, 5659 and 9501 are divided by 1921,

To find the remainder when 3738, 5659, and 9501 are divided by 1921, we calculate as follows:

For 3738 divided by 1921:

Remainder of 3738 divided by 1921 = 3738 - (floor(3738/1921) × 1921)

floor(3738/1921) = 1

Therefore, the remainder = 3738 - (1 × 1921) = 3738 - 1921 = 1817

For 5659 divided by 1921:

Remainder of 5659 divided by 1921 = 5659 - (floor(5659/1921) × 1921)

floor(5659/1921) = 2

Therefore, the remainder = 5659 - (2 × 1921) = 5659 - 3842 = 1817

For 9501 divided by 1921:

Remainder of 9501 divided by 1921 = 9501 - (floor(9501/1921) × 1921)

floor(9501/1921) = 4

Therefore, the remainder = 9501 - (4 × 1921) = 9501 - 7684 = 1817

So, the remainder when 3738, 5659, and 9501 are divided by 1921 is each 1817.

Remainder (y) = 1817

Now,

x + y = 1921 + 1817 = 3738

question: Pipes A and B together can fill a tank in 16 hours, whereas pipe C alone can empty the full tank in 24 hours. A and B were opened together for 10 hours and then closed. Pipe C was then opened. The tank will now be emptied by C in:
question_hi: पाइप A और B एक टैंक को 16 घंटे में भर सकते है, जबकि पाइप C अकेले पूरे टैंक को 24 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। A और B को एक साथ 10 घंटे के लिए खोला गया और फिर बंद कर दिया गया। फिर पाइप C को खोला गया। अब C द्वारा टैंक कितने समय में खाली किया जा सकेगा?
solution:
Given:-

(A + B) fill a tank in = 16 Hours

C can empty in = 24 Hours

Calculation:-

(A + B) fill a tank in 1 hour = 1/16

∴ (A + B) fill a tank in 10 hours = \(\large{\frac{1}{16}}\) × 10 = Available quantity in tank

C emptied the tank in 1 hour = 1/24

∴ Time taken by C in emptied the tank = (10/16)/(1/24)

Time taken by C = 240/16 = 15 hours.

Shortcut Trick

The efficiency of A and B is 3 and the efficiency of C is (-2)

Work done by pipe A and B in 10 hours = 3 × 10 = 30

Pipe C empty 30 units in 30/2 = 15 hours

∴ Required time is 15 hours.
solution_hi:
दिया है:-

(A + B) एक टैंक भरते हैं = 16 घंटे में

C खाली कर सकता है = 24 घंटे में

गणना:-

(A + B) 1 घंटे में एक टैंक का भरते हैं = 1/16

∴ (A + B) एक टैंक को 10 घंटे में भरते हैं = \(\large{\frac{1}{16}}\) × 10 = टैंक में उपलब्ध मात्रा

C ने टैंक को 1 घंटे में खाली किया = 1/24

∴ C द्वारा टैंक को खाली करने में लिया गया समय = (10/16)/(1/24)

C द्वारा लिया गया समय = 240/16 = 15 घंटे.

Shortcut Trick 

A और B की दक्षता 3 है और C की दक्षता (-2) है 

पाइप A और B द्वारा 10 घंटे में किया गया कार्य = 3 × 10 = 30

पाइप C द्वारा 30 इकाई खाली करने के लिए लिया गया समय 30/2 = 15 घंटा

∴ आवश्यक समय 15 घंटे है।

question: A certain sum (in Rs) is invested at simple interest at x% p.a for 5 years. Had it been invested at (x + 5)% p.a the simple interest would have been Rs. 9,200 more than the earlier one. What is the sum?
question_hi: 5 वर्षों के लिए एक निश्चित राशि (रुपये में) को साधारण ब्याज पर x% प्रति वर्ष में निवेश किया जाता है। यदि इसे (x + 5)% प्रति वर्ष पर निवेश किया गया होता तो साधारण ब्याज पहले की तुलना में 9,200 रुपये अधिक होता। मूल राशि क्या है?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Difference of rate for 1 years = 5%

Difference of rate 5 years = 5 × 5 = 25%

 For 25% = 9200

∴ For 100% = Rs. 36800

∴ The sum is Rs. 36,800.

Alternate Method

Given:-

SI = 9200, r% = x% and t = 5 years

Formula used:-

SI = (P × r × t)/100

Calculation:-

According to the question-

[{P × (x + 5) × 5}/100] – [(P × x × 5)/100] = 9200

5Px + 25P – 5Px = 920000

25P = 920000

P = 920000/25

P = Rs. 36,800

∴ The sum is Rs. 36,800.
solution_hi:
दिया है:-

साधारण ब्याज = 9200, r% = x% और t = 5 वर्ष

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:-

SI = (P x r x t)/100

गणना:-

प्रश्न के अनुसार-

[{P x (x + 5) x 5}/100] - [(P x x x 5)/100] = 9200

5Px + 25P - 5Px = 920000

25P = 920000

P = 920000/25

P = 36800 रुपये

Shortcut Trick

1 साल के लिए दर का अंतर = 5%

5 साल के लिए दर का अंतर = 5 x 5 = 25%

25% = 9200

100% = 36800 रुपये

question: The profit on selling an article for Rs. 1,100 is equal to three times the amount of loss on selling it for Rs 700. To gain 12.5% the article must be sold for:
question_hi: 1,100 रुपये में एक वस्तु को बेचने पर अर्जित किया गया लाभ उसी वस्तु को 700 रुपये में बेचने पर अर्जित हानि के तीन गुना के बराबर है। 12.5% का लाभ हासिल करने के लिए वस्तु को कितनी कीमत पर बेचना पड़ेगा?
solution:
Given:-

First S.P. = 1100

Second SP. = 700

Formula used:-

%Profit = [(S.P - CP)/CP] × 100

Calculation:-

Let CP of the article be x

According to the question

(1100 – x) = 3 (x – 700)

1100 – x = 3x – 2100

3x + x = 2100 + 1100

4x = 3200

x = 800

∴ SP of the article = 800 × (9/8) = Rs. 900

Shortcut Trick Calculation:-

4 unit = 400

1 unit = 100

3 unit = 300

CP = 800

∴ SP of the article = 800 × (9/8) = Rs. 900
solution_hi:
त्वरित विधि:

4 इकाई = 400

1 इकाई = 100

3 इकाई = 300

CP = 800

वस्तु का नया SP = 800 × (9/8) = Rs. 900

विस्तृत हल:

माना कि वस्तु का CP x है। 

प्रश्नानुसार,

(1100 – x) = 3 (x – 700)

1100 – x = 3x – 2100

3x + x = 2100 + 1100

4x = 3200

x = 800

वस्तु का SP = 800 × (9/8) = 900 रुपये

question: If x<sup>4</sup> + x<sup>2</sup>y<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>4</sup> = 21/256 and x<sup>2</sup> + xy + y<sup>2</sup> = 3/16, then 2(x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup>) = ?
question_hi: यदि x<sup>4</sup> + x<sup>2</sup>y<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>4</sup> = 21/256 और x<sup>2</sup> + xy + y<sup>2</sup> = 3/16, तो 2(x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup>) = ?
solution:
Given:

⇒ (x2 + xy + y2) = 3/16                   ---(1)

⇒ (x4 + x2y2 + y4) = 21/256            ---(2)

Formula used:

As we know the following identity,

⇒ (x2 + y2 + xy) (x2 + y2 - xy) = (x2 + y2)2 - (xy)2

⇒ (x2 + y2 + xy) (x2 + y2 - xy) = x4 + y4 + 2x2y2 - x2y2

⇒ (x2 + y2 + xy) (x2 + y2 - xy) = x4 + y4 + x2y2

Calculation:

⇒ x4 + y4 + x2y2 = (x2 + y2 + xy) (x2 + y2 - xy)

⇒ (21/256) = (3/16) (x2 – xy + y2)

⇒ (x2 – xy + y2) = 7/16      ---(2)

Add equation (1) and equation (2)

⇒ 2(x2 + y2) = 10/16 = 5/8
solution_hi:
दिया हुआ:

⇒ (x2 + xy + y2 ) = 3/16           ---(1)

⇒ (x4 + x2y2 + y4) = 21/256       ---(2)

उपयोग किया गया सूत्र:

जैसा कि हम निम्नलिखित सार्वसमिका से जानते हैं,

⇒ (x2 + y2 + xy) (x2 + y2 - xy) = (x2 + y2 )2 - (xy)2

⇒ (x2 + y 2 + xy) (x2 + y2 - xy) = x4 + y4 + 2x2 y2 - x2 y2

⇒ (x2 + y2 + xy) (x2 + y2 - xy) = x4 + y4 + x2 y2

गणना:

⇒ x4 + y4 + x2 y2 = (x2 + y2 + xy) (x2 + y2 - xy)

⇒ (21/256) = (3/16) (x2 - xy + y2 )

⇒ (x2 - xy + y2 ) = 7/16      --- (2)

समीकरण (1) और समीकरण (2) जोड़ें

⇒ 2(x 2 + y 2 ) = 10/16 = 5/8

question: If 2sinθ + 15cos2θ = 7, 0° < θ < 90° then what is the value of \(\frac{{3 - tan\theta }}{{2\; + \;tan\theta }}?\)
question_hi: यदि 2sinθ + 15cos2θ = 7, 0° < θ < 90° तो \(\frac{{3 - tan\theta }}{{2\; + \;tan\theta }}?\)
solution:
Given:-

2sin θ + 15cos2θ = 7

Calculation:-

2sin θ + 15(1 – sin2θ) = 7

2sin θ + 15 – 15sin2θ – 7 = 0

15sin2θ – 2sinθ – 8 = 0

15sin2θ – 12sinθ + 10sinθ – 8 = 0

3sinθ(5sinθ – 4) + 2(5sinθ – 4) = 0

(3sinθ + 2) (5sinθ – 4) = 0

Taking,

3sin θ + 2 = 0

sin θ = -2/3 (Not possible)

Taking,

(5sin θ – 4) = 0

sin θ = 4/5

Perpendicular = P, Hypotenuse = H and Base = B

sin θ = P/H = 4/5

H2 = P2 + B2

52 = 42 + B2

B2 = 25 – 16 = 9

B = √9 = 3

tan θ = P/B = 4/3

Now,

(3 – tan θ)/(2 + tan θ)

(3 – 4/3)/(2 + 4/3)

5/10

1/2

3sinθ(5sinθ – 4) + 2(5sinθ – 4) = 0

sin θ = P/H = 4/5

question: A right circular cone of the largest volume is cut out from a solid wooden hemisphere. The remaining material is what percentage of the volume of the original hemisphere?
question_hi: अधिकतम आयतन वाले एक लंब वृत्तीय शंकु को एक ठोस लकड़ी के अर्द्धगोले से काटा जाता है। शेष सामग्री मूल अर्द्धगोले के आयतन का कितना प्रतिशत है?
solution:
Given:-

A right circular cone of largest volume

Formula used:-

Volume of cone = \(\dfrac{1}{3}\)πr2h

Volume of hemisphere = (2/3)πr3

Calculation:-

 

The radius of the cone and hemisphere be r cm.

Height of the cone h = r cm

Volume of cone = \(\dfrac{1}{3}\)πr2 × h

⇒ \(\dfrac{1}{3}\)πr2 × r = \(\dfrac{1}{3}\)πr3

Volume of hemisphere = \(\dfrac{2}{3}\)πr3

Remaining volume = \(\dfrac{2}{3}\)πr3 – \(\dfrac{1}{3}\)πr3 = \(\dfrac{1}{3}\)πr3

Required percentage = \(\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{3}\pi r^3}{\dfrac{2}{3}\pi r^3}\) × 100

⇒ \(\dfrac{1}{3}\) × \(\dfrac{3}{2}\) × 100 = 50%
solution_hi:
दिया है:-

अधिकतम आयतन का एक लंब वृत्तीय शंकु

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:-

शंकु का आयतन = (1/3)πr2h

अर्द्धगोले का आयतन = (2/3)πr3

गणना:-

माना कि शंकु और अर्द्धगोले की त्रिज्या r सेंटीमीटर है। 

शंकु की ऊँचाई h = r सेंटीमीटर

शंकु का आयतन = \(\dfrac{1}{3}\)πr2 × h

⇒ \(\dfrac{1}{3}\)πr2 × r = \(\dfrac{1}{3}\)πr3

अर्द्धगोले का आयतन = \(\dfrac{2}{3}\)πr3

शेष आयतन = \(\dfrac{2}{3}\)πr3 – \(\dfrac{1}{3}\)πr3 = \(\dfrac{1}{3}\)πr3

अपेक्षित प्रतिशत = \(\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{3}\pi r^3}{\dfrac{2}{3}\pi r^3}\) × 100

⇒ \(\dfrac{1}{3}\) × \(\dfrac{2}{3}\) × 100 = 50%

question: The average of eleven numbers is 68. The average of the first four numbers is 78 and that of the next four numbers is 63. The 9<sup>th</sup> number is two times the 11<sup>th</sup> number and the 10<sup>th</sup> number is 4 less than the 11<sup>th</sup> number. What is the average of the 9<sup>th</sup> and 11<sup>th</sup> numbers?
question_hi: ग्यारह संख्याओं का औसत 68 है। पहली चार संख्याओं का औसत 78 है और अलगी चार संख्याओं का औसत 63 है। 9वीं संख्या 11वीं संख्या की दोगुनी है तथा 10वीं संख्या 11वीं संख्या से 4 कम है। 9वीं और 11वीं संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?
solution:
Given:-

Average of 11 numbers = 68

Average of first 4 numbers = 78

Average of next 4 numbers = 63

Formula used:-

Average = (Sum of values)/No. of values

Calculation:-

Average of 1 numbers = 68

Sum of 11 numbers = 68 × 11 = 748

Average of 4 numbers = 78

Sum of 4 numbers = 78 × 4 = 312

Average of next 4 numbers = 63

Sum of next 4 numbers = 63 × 4 = 252

Sum of 9th, 10th and 11th numbers

748 – 312 – 252 = 184

Let 11th number be x

9th number = 2x

10th number = x – 4

According to the question

x + 2x + x – 4 = 184

4x = 184 + 4 = 188

x = 47

11th number = 47

9th number = 2 × 47 = 94

Average of 9th number = (47 + 94)/2 = 141/2 = 70.5

Alternate Method

Average of 11 number = 68

Deviation of first 4 number = (68 – 78) × 4 = (-40)

Deviation of next 4 number = (68 – 63) × 4 = 20

Sum of 9th, 10th and 11th numbers = 3 × 68 – 40 + 20 = 184

According to the question

x + 2x + x – 4 = 184

4x = 184 + 4 = 188

x = 47

11th number = 47

9th number = 2 × 47 = 94

Average of 9th number = (47 + 94)/2 = 141/2 = 70.5
solution_hi:
दिया है:-

11 संख्याओं का औसत = 68

पहली 4 संख्याओं का औसत = 78

अगली 4 संख्याओं का औसत = 63

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:-

औसत = (मानों का योग)/मानों की संख्या

गणना:-

11 संख्याओं का औसत = 68

11 संख्याओं का योग = 68 × 11 = 748

4 संख्याओं का औसत = 78

4 संख्याओं का योग = 78 × 4 = 312

अगली 4 संख्याओं का योग = 63

अगली 4 संख्याओं का योग = 63 × 4 = 252

9वीं, 10वीं और 11वीं संख्याओं का योग 

748 – 312 – 252 = 184

माना कि 11वीं संख्या x है 

9वीं संख्या = 2x

10वीं संख्या = x – 4

प्रश्नानुसार,

x + 2x + x – 4 = 184

4x = 184 + 4 = 188

x = 47

11वीं संख्या = 47

9वीं संख्या = 2 × 47 = 94

question: In an office, 70% of the total number of employees are females. 80% of the total number of employees, including 35 males, got promotion. If there are 105 female employees, then what percentage of female employees got promotion?
question_hi: एक कार्यालय में, कर्मचारियों की कुल संख्या का 70% महिलाएँ हैं। 35 पुरुषों सहित कुल कर्मचारियों के 80% को पदोन्नति मिली। अगर 105 महिला कर्मचारी हैं, तो कितनी प्रतिशत महिला कर्मचारियों को पदोन्नति मिली?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Total female employees = 105 (which is 70% of total)

Total employees = 105 ÷ 0.7 = 150

Total promoted = 80% of 150 = 120

Female promoted = Total promoted − Male promoted = 120 − 35 = 85

Required % = (85 ÷ 105) × 100 ≈ 80.95%

∴ The correct answer is 80.95%.

Alternate Method

Given:

Females = 70% of Total Employees = 105

Promoted employees = 80% of Total Employees

Promoted males = 35

Calculations:

⇒ Total employees = (105 ÷ 70) × 100 = 150

⇒ Total promoted employees = 80% of 150 = (80/100) × 150 = 120

⇒ Number of promoted females = Total promoted − Promoted males

⇒ Number of promoted females = 120 − 35 = 85

⇒ Percentage of female employees promoted = (Promoted females ÷ Total females) × 100

⇒ Required % = (85 ÷ 105) × 100 = (17 ÷ 21) × 100 ≈ 80.95%

∴ The correct answer is 80.95%.

Additional Information

Percentage Base Change

Always ensure the denominator (base) is the specific group asked for. Here, the base is total female employees (105), not the total office staff (150).

Percentage Formula

Percentage = (Value ÷ Total Value) × 100. This is the fundamental ratio used to compare parts of a whole.

question: The average score of 42 students in a test is 69. The ratio of the number of boys to that of girls us 10 : 11. The average score of the boys is 20% more than that of the girls. The average score of the boys is:
question_hi: एक टेस्ट में 42 छात्रों का औसत स्कोर 69 है। लड़कों और लड़कियों की संख्या का अनुपात 10 : 11 है। लड़कों का औसत स्कोर लड़कियों की तुलना में 20% अधिक है। लड़कों का औसत स्कोर क्या है?
solution:
Given:-

Average of 42 students = 69

Ratio of boys to girls = 10 : 11

Average score of boys = 1.20 × average score of girls

Formula used:-

Average = (Sum of values)/No. of values

Calculation:-

Let the average score of girls be 5x.

Average score of boys = 5x × (120/100) = 5x × (6/5) = 6x

Number of boys = 42 × (10/21) = 20

Number of girls = 42 × (11/21) = 22

Average score of 42 students = 69

According to the question,

6x × 20 + 5x × 22 = 69 × 42

60x + 55x = 69 × 21

115x = 1449

x = 1449/115

x = 12.6

Average score of boys = 6 × 12.6 = 75.6

42 छात्रों का औसत = 69

लड़कों का औसत स्कोर = 6 × 12.6 = 75.6

question: A works twice as fast as B and B works twice as fast as C. All three working together can finish a task in 4 days with the help of D. If D alone can finish the same task in 16 days, then in how many days will A alone finish 75% of the same task?
question_hi: A, B से दोगुने तेज़ी से कार्य करता है और B C से दोगुने तेज़ी से कार्य करता है। वे तीनों साथ मिलकर कार्य करते हुए D की मदद से कार्य को 4 दिन में पूरा कर सकते हैं। यदि D अकेले उस कार्य को 16 दिन में पूरा कर सकता है, तो A कितने दिनों में अकेले कार्य का 75% पूरा कर पाएगा?

75% of the total work A alone can complete in = 12/(12/7) = 7 days

question: A can finish one-third of a work in 5 days, B can finish 2/5 the of the same work in 10 days and C can finish 75% of the same work in 15 days. They work together for 6 days. The remaining work will be finished by B alone in:
question_hi: A एक कार्य के एक-तिहाई हिस्से को 5 दिन में पूरा कर सकता है, B उसी कार्य के 2/5 हिस्से को 10 दिन में पूरा कर सकता है और C उसी कार्य के 75% हिस्से को 15 दिन में पूरा कर सकता है। वे तीनों साथ मिलकर 6 दिन तक कार्य करते हैं। B अकेले शेष कार्य को कितने दिन में पूरा कर सकता है?
solution:
Given:

A can finish one-third of a work in 5 days.

B can finish 2/5 the of the same work in 10 days.

And C can finish 75% of the same work in 15 days.

Calculation:

A can finish 1/3 of a work in = 5 days

A finish the whole work in = 5 × 3 = 15 days

B can 2/5 of the whole work in = 10 days

B can finish the whole work in = 10 × (5/2) = 25

C can finish 75% of the work in 15 days

C can finish the whole work = 15 × (100/75) = 20 days 

A, B and C work in 6 days = (20 + 12 + 15) × 6 = 282

Remaining work = 300 – 282 = 18

Remaining work B will complete in = 18/12 = 3/2 = \(1\frac{1}{2}\) days
solution_hi:
दिया हुआ:

A एक कार्य के एक-तिहाई हिस्से को 5 दिन में पूरा कर सकता है।

गणना:

A, B और C, 6 दिन तक कार्य करते हैं = (20 + 12 + 15) × 6 = 282

शेष कार्य = 300 – 282 = 18

B द्वारा अकेले शेष कार्य को पूरा करने के लिए लिया गया समय = 18/12 = 3/2 = \(1\frac{1}{2}\) दिन

question: The volume of a solid right circular cylinder is 5236 cm<sup>3</sup>, and its height is 34 cm. what is its curved surface area (in cm<sup>2</sup>)? (Take π = 22/7)

question: The value of 8 ÷ [(9 – 5) ÷ {(4 ÷ 2 of 4) – (8 ÷ 8 of 16) + (4 × 2 ÷ 8)}] is:

question: P is a point outside a circle and is 26 cm away from its centre. A secant PAB drawn from P intersects the circle at point A and B such that PB = 32 cm and PA = 18 cm. The radius of the circle (in cm) is:

⇒ 262 – r2 = 576

⇒ r2 = 676 – 576

⇒ r2 = 100

⇒ r = √ 100 = 10 cm

question: A conical vessel whose internal base radius is 18 cm and height 60 cm are full of a liquid. The entire liquid of the vessel is emptied into a cylindrical vessel with an internal radius of 15 cm. The height (in cm) to which the liquid rises in the cylindrical vessel is:

question: If \(\frac{{8x}}{{2{x^2}\; + \;7x - 2}} = 1,x > 0,\) then what is the value of \({x^3} + \frac{1}{{{x^3}}}\)?
question_hi: यदि \(\frac{{8x}}{{2{x^2}\; + \;7x - 2}} = 1,x > 0,\) तो \({x^3} + \frac{1}{{{x^3}}}\)का मान क्या है?
solution:
8x/(2x2 + 7x – 2) = 1

2x2 + 7x – 2 = 8x

Divided by x

2x + 7 – 2/x = 8

2(x – 1/x) = 8 – 7 = 1

x – 1/x = 1/2

As we know,

(x + 1/x)2 – (x – 1/x)2 = 4

(x + 1/x)2 = 4 + (1/2)2 = 4 + (1/4)

(x + 1/x)2 = 17/4

x + 1/x = √17/2

As we know,

x3 + 1/x3 = (x + 1/x)3 – 3(x + 1/x)

x3 + 1/x3 = (√17/2)3 – 3 × (√17/2)

= 17√17/8 – 3√17/2

= (17√17 – 12√17)/8

= 5√17/8

question: If a discount of 10% is allowed on the marked price of an article. A shopkeeper gets a profit of 25%. If he offers a discount of 25% on the marked price of the same article, then his percentage profit/loss will be:
question_hi: यदि एक वस्तु के चिह्नित मूल्य पर 10% की छूट दी जाती है, तो एक दुकानदार को 25% का लाभ होगा। यदि वह उसी वस्तु के चिह्नित मूल्य पर 25% की छूट देता है, तो उसके द्वारा अर्जित लाभ/हानि प्रतिशत क्या होगा?
solution:

Profit percentage = 25%

Calculation:

Let MP of the article be 100.

SP of the article = 100 × \(90\over100\) = 90

New SP of the article = 100 × \(75\over100\) = 75

Profit percentage = \((75-72)\over72\) × 100 = \(4\frac{1}{6}\%\) profit.

∴ The percentage profit is \(4\frac{1}{6}\%\).

question: A sum of Rs. 5,000 amounts to Rs. 7,200 in 8 years at a certain rate per cent p.a interest compounded yearly. What will be the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 6,550 in 4 years at the same rate of interest?
question_hi: चक्रवृद्धि दर पर वार्षिक रूप से 5,000 रुपये की राशि 8 वर्षों में एक निश्चित दर पर 7,200 रुपये हो गई। 6,550 रुपये की राशि पर 4 वर्षों के लिए उसी दर पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज क्या होगा?
solution:
Given:

A sum of Rs. 5,000 amounts to Rs. 7,200 in 8 years at a certain rate percent p.a interest compounded yearly.

Calculation:

As we know,

7200 = 5000 (1 + r/100)8

A = P (1 + r/100)t

A = 6550 (1 + r/100)4

A = 6550 × 6/5

A = 7860

CI = 7860 – 6550 = 1310 

Shortcut Trick √5000 : √7200

√25 : √36

5 : 6

5 unit = 6550

1 unit = 6550/5 = 1310

question: ABCD is cyclic quadrilateral. Sides AB and DC, when produced, meet at E, and sides BC and AD, when produced, meet at F. If ∠BFA = 60° and ∠AED = 30°, then the measure of ∠ABC is:
question_hi: ABCD एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज है। भुजाएँ AB और DC, जब विस्तृत की जाती हैं तो, बिंदु E पर मिलती हैं, और भुजाएँ BC और AD, जब विस्तृत की जाती हैं तो, बिंदु F पर मिलती हैं। यदि ∠BFA = 60° और ∠AED = 30°, तो ∠ABC का माप क्या है?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

For a cyclic quadrilateral ABCD where sides AB, DC meet at E and BC, AD meet at F:

∠ABC = [180° + ∠AED − ∠BFA] ÷ 2

∠ABC = [180° + 30° − 60°] ÷ 2

∠ABC = 150° ÷ 2 = 75°

∴ The correct answer is 75°.

Alternate Method

Given: ∠BFA = 60°, ∠AED = 30°

Formula Used: Sum of opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°. Sum of angles in a triangle is 180°.

Let ∠ABC = x and ∠BCD = y.

⇒ In ΔEBC, ∠E + ∠EBC + ∠ECB = 180°

⇒ 30° + (180° − x) + (180° − y) = 180°

⇒ x + y = 210° ... (1)

⇒ In cyclic quad ABCD, ∠ADC = 180° − x.

⇒ In ΔFDC, ∠F + ∠FCD + ∠FDC = 180°

⇒ 60° + (180° − y) + (180° − (180° − x)) = 180°

⇒ 60° + 180° − y + x = 180°

⇒ y − x = 60° ... (2)

⇒ Adding equations (1) and (2): 2y = 270° ⇒ y = 135°

⇒ Subtracting equation (2) from (1): 2x = 150° ⇒ x = 75°

∴ The correct answer is 75°.

Additional Information

Cyclic Quadrilateral Properties

The sum of opposite angles is 180°. The exterior angle at any vertex is equal to the interior opposite angle.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of any triangle is always 180°.

Intersecting Chords Theorem

If two chords intersect inside a circle, the product of the segments of one chord equals the product of the segments of the other (PA × PB = PC × PD).
solution_hi:
Shortcut Trick

एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज (cyclic quadrilateral) ABCD के लिए जहाँ भुजाएँ AB, DC बिंदु E पर और BC, AD बिंदु F पर मिलती हैं:

∠ABC = [180° + ∠AED − ∠BFA] ÷ 2

∠ABC = [180° + 30° − 60°] ÷ 2

∠ABC = 150° ÷ 2 = 75°

∴ सही उत्तर 75° है।

Alternate Method

माना ∠ABC = x और ∠BCD = y.

⇒ ΔEBC में, ∠E + ∠EBC + ∠ECB = 180°

⇒ 30° + (180° − x) + (180° − y) = 180°

⇒ x + y = 210° ... (1)

⇒ चक्रीय चतुर्भुज ABCD में, ∠ADC = 180° − x.

⇒ ΔFDC में, ∠F + ∠FCD + ∠FDC = 180°

⇒ 60° + (180° − y) + (180° − (180° − x)) = 180°

⇒ 60° + 180° − y + x = 180°

⇒ y − x = 60° ... (2)

⇒ समीकरण (1) और (2) को जोड़ने पर: 2y = 270° ⇒ y = 135°

⇒ समीकरण (1) में से समीकरण (2) को घटाने पर: 2x = 150° ⇒ x = 75°

∴ सही उत्तर 75° है।

Additional Information

चक्रीय चतुर्भुज के गुण (Cyclic Quadrilateral Properties)

सम्मुख कोणों का योग 180° होता है। किसी भी शीर्ष पर बाह्य कोण, आंतरिक सम्मुख कोण के बराबर होता है।

किसी भी त्रिभुज के सभी आंतरिक कोणों का योग हमेशा 180° होता है।

question: Seven years ago, the ages (in years) of A and B were in the ratio 4 : 5 and 7 years hence, their ages will be in the ratio 5 : 6. What will be the ratio of their ages 5 years from now?
question_hi: सात साल पहले, A और B की आयु (वर्षों में) 4 : 5 के अनुपात में थी और 7 साल बाद, उनकी आयु 5 : 6 के अनुपात में होगी। अब से 5 साल बाद उनकी आयु का अनुपात क्या होगा?
solution:
Given:

Seven years ago = 4 : 5

Seven years hence = 5 : 6

Calculation:

Ages ratio of A and B seven years ago = 4x : 5x

According to the question,

⇒ (4x + 14)/(5x + 14) = 5/6

⇒ 6(4x + 14) = 5(5x + 14)

⇒ 24x + 84 = 25x + 70

⇒ 25x – 24x = 84 – 70

⇒ x = 14

Seven years ago age of A = 4 × 14 = 56

5 years after the age of A = 56 + 12 = 68

Seven years ago age of B = 5 × 14 = 70

5years hence age of B = 70 + 12 = 82

Ratio of ages of A to that of B = 68 : 82 = 34 : 41

∴ The correct answer is 34 : 41.

Alternate Method

⇒ 1 unit = 14

⇒ 4 unit = 4 × 14 = 56

⇒ 5 unit = 5 × 14 = 70

5 years after the age of A = 56 + 12 = 68

Seven years ago age of B = 70

5years hence age of B = 70 + 12 = 82

Ratio of ages of A to that of B = 68 : 82 = 34 : 41

question: Pipes A and B are emptying pipes and can empty a tank in 6 hours and 16 hours, respectively. C is a filling pipe. All three pipes were opened together. They took 80 minutes to empty 5/18<sup>th</sup> of the tank. Pipe C alone can fill the tank in:
question_hi: पाइप A और B खाली करने वाले पाइप हैं और क्रमशः 6 घंटे और 16 घंटे में एक टैंक खाली  कर सकते हैं। C एक भरने वाला पाइप है। तीनों पाइप एक साथ खोले गए। उन्हें टैंक का 5/18वां हिस्सा खाली करने में 80 मिनट का समय लगा। पाइप C अकेले कितने समय में टैंक को भर सकता है?
solution:
Given:

A pipe = 6 hours

B pipe = 16 hours

Time = 80 minutes to empty 5/18 of the tank

Formula used:

Capacity = time × efficiency

Calculation:

Let the efficiency of Pipe C be x, then

(8 + 3 – x) × 80/60 = 48 × 5/18

(11 – x) × 4/3 = 40/3

(11 – x) = 10

x = 11 – 10

x = 1

Pipe C alone can empty the tank in 48/1 = 48 hrs

∴ The correct answer is 48 hrs.

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

क्षमता = समय × दक्षता

question: Let x be the least number divisible by 13, such that when x is divided by 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 12, the remainder in each case is 2. The sum of the digits of x is:
question_hi: माना कि x 13 से विभाज्य न्यूनतम संख्या इस प्रकार है कि जब x को 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 और 12 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो प्रत्येक मामले में शेषफल 2 है। x के अंकों का योग क्या है?
solution:
Calculation:

LCM = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 × 7 = 840

Let (840k + 2) be divisible by 13, then

Quotient = 64k and Remainder = (8k + 2)

Put k = 1, 2, 3, 4…

So, put k = 3

Remainder = (8 × 3 + 2) = 26

⇒ 26/13 = 2

Now,

⇒ 840k + 2

⇒ 840 × 3 + 2

⇒ 2520 + 2

⇒ 2522

Sum of digit of 2522 = 2 + 5 + 2 + 2 = 11

∴ The correct answer is 11.

question: The speed of train A is 16 km/h less than the speed of train B. To cover a distance of 384 km, B takes 4 hours less time than A. What is the speed (in km/h) of train B?
question_hi: ट्रेन A की गति ट्रेन B की गति से 16 किलोमीटर/घंटा कम है। 384 किलोमीटर की दूरी तय करने के लिए, ट्रेन B ट्रेन A से 4 घंटे कम समय लेती है। ट्रेन B की गति (किलोमीटर/घंटा में) क्या है?
solution:
Given:

Speed of train B - Speed of train A = 16 km/h

Distance = 384 km

Time of A - Time of B = 4 hours

Calculation:

Let speed of Train B be x km/hr.

⇒ Speed of Train A = (x – 16) km/hr

According to the question,

{384/(x – 16)} – {384/x} = 4

384[(x – x + 16)/{x(x – 16)}] = 4

384 × 16/(x2 – 16x) = 4

384 × 4 = x2 – 16x

x2 – 16x – 1536 = 0

x2 – 48x + 32n – 1536 = 0

x(x – 48) + 32(x – 48) = 0

(x – 48) (x + 32) = 0

Taking ,

x + 32 = 0

x = -32 [Speed can not be negative]

Taking,

x – 48 = 0

x = 48

∴ Speed of Train B is 48 km/hr.

Shortcut Trick With the help of option

Let speed of train B be 48 km/hr

384/32 – 384/48 = 4

12 – 8 = 4

4 = 4 (Satisfied)

question: In ΔABC, ∠C = 90° and D is a point on CB such that AD is the bisector of ∠A. If AC = 5 cm and BC = 12 cm, then what is the length of AD?
question_hi: ΔABC में, ∠C = 90° और D CB पर एक बिंदु इस प्रकार है कि AD ∠A का समद्विभजाक है। यदि AC = 5 सेंटीमीटर और BC = 12 सेंटीमीटर, तो AD की लंबाई क्या है?
solution:
Given:

∠C = 90° 

AC = 5 cm

BC = 12 cm

D is a point on CB such that AD is the bisector of ∠A

Concept used:

∴AC/AB = CD/DB

Calculation:

BC = 12, AC = 5

In △ABC

(AB)2 = (AC)2 + (BC)2

(AB)2 = 52 + 122 = 25 + 144 = 169

AB = √169 = 13

∵ AD is the angle bisector of ∠A.

⇒ AC/AB = CD/DB

5/13 = CD/DB

Suppose CD : DB = 5x : 13x

BC = CD + DB

12 = 5x + 13x

18x = 12

x = 12/18 = 2/3

CD = 5 × 2/3 = 10/3

In △ACD

(AD)2 = (CD)2 + (AC)2

(AD)22 = (10/3)2 + 52

AD2 = 100/9 + 25

AD2 = (100 + 225)/9 = 325/9

AD = 5√13/3

∴ The correct answer is 5√13/3.

question: The length of parallel sides of a trapezium are 51 cm and 21 cm, and that of each of the other two sides is 39 cm. What is the area (in cm<sup>2</sup>) of the trapezium?
question_hi: एक समलंब के दो समानांतर भुजाओं की लंबाई 51 सेंटीमीटर और 21 सेंटीमीटर है, तथा अन्य दो भुजाओं में प्रत्येक की लंबाई 39 सेंटीमीटर है। समलंब का क्षेत्रफल (सेंटीमीटर<sup>2</sup> में) क्या है?
solution:
Given:

Length of parallel sides = 51 cm, 21 cm

Length of other two sides = 39 cm

Formula used:

Area of trapezium = 1/2 × (Sum of parallel side) × (Distance between parallel side)

Calculation:

As we know

Area of trapezium = 1/2 × (Sum of parallel side) × (Distance between parallel side)

ABCD is a trapezium

AB = 21, CD = 51, BC = AD = 39

AB = EF = 21 cm and DE = FC

CD = DE + EF + FC

⇒ 51 = DE + 21 + DE

⇒ 2DE = 51 – 21 = 30

⇒ DE = 30/2 = 15

In △BFC

⇒ BC2 = BF2 + FC2

⇒ (39)2 = BF2 + (15)2

⇒ BF2 = 1521 – 225 = 1296

⇒ BF = √1296 = 36 cm

Area of trapezium = 1/2 × (51 + 21) × 36 = 72 × 18 = 1296 m2 

∴ The correct answer is 1296 m2.

समानांतर भुजाओं की लंबाई = 51 सेमी, 21 सेमी

अन्य दो भुजाओं की लंबाई = 39 सेमी

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

समलम्ब चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 × (समानांतर भुजा का योग) × (समानांतर भुजा के बीच की दूरी)

गणना:

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं,

समलंब का क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 × (समानांतर भुजाओं का योग) × (समानांतर भुजाओं के बीच की दूरी)

AB = 21, CD = 51, BC = AD = 39

CD = DE + EF + FC

2DE = 51 – 21 = 30

DE = 30/2 = 15

△BFC में,

BC2 = BF2 + FC2

(39)2 = BF2 + (15)2

BF2 = 1521 – 225 = 1296

BF = √1296 = 36 सेंटीमीटर 

समलंब का क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 × (51 + 21) × 36 = 72 × 18 = 1296 मीटर2

∴ सही उत्तर 1296 मीटर2 है।

question: If \(66\frac{2}{3}\%\) of 75% of one-eighth of a certain number is 179, then \(33\frac{1}{3}\%\) of three-fourth of that number is:

question: The total daily sales of newspaper P in cities, B, D and E is what percentage less than that of newspaper Q in cities A, C, D and E?
question_hi: B, D और E शहरों में अख़बार P की कुल दैनिक बिक्री A, C, D और E शहरों में अख़बार Q की कुल बिक्री से कितना प्रतिशत कम है?
solution:
Calculation:

Total sales of newspaper P in cities B, D, and E

= 560 + 750 + 550

= 1860

Total sales of newspaper Q in cities A, C, D, and E

= 450 + 650 + 680 + 620

= 2400

Required percentage = [(2400 – 1860)/2400] × 100

= 22.5%

question: What is the ratio of the total daily sales of newspaper P in cities A and C to the total daily sales of newspaper Q in cities B and D?
question_hi: A और C शहरों में अख़बार P की कुल दैनिक बिक्री तथा B और D शहरों में अख़बार Q की कुल दैनिक बिक्री का अनुपात क्या है?
solution:
Total sales of newspaper P in cities A and C = 640 + 480 = 1120

Total sales of newspaper Q in cities B and D = 600 + 680 = 1280

Required ratio = 1120 : 1280 = 7 : 8
